answer: Let each Sybil node bond B0=2e12 lamports and submit a zero-knowledge verifiable delay chain of t=10^6 epochs; a cluster of k attackers faces capital scaling k^2B0 plus quadratic slashing λk^2, where λ=1.8e11 lamports per forged slot, so marginal cost C_m=2B0k+2λk exceeds extracted value V=1.2e11k. The ferrous collateral pool, drained as a plume of slashed stake into public burn, converts any profitable attack into negative expected utility E=V-C_m<0. Hence robust Nash equilibrium holds honest collateral above 51% security threshold and leaves an ember of rent.
